snippet.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time to burn rubber in the final stretch of the biggest race of the year.
 
Cross into new dimensions & unleash the full power of your ultimate racing machine in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds. There's only room for one on top of the winner's podium.
 
Come Race on Our Level.

Pre-order here: https://RaceCrossWorlds.com
